 Venezia vs. Internazionale - Head-to-head record
 Inter have dominated this fixture in recent years , winning all five of the clubs’ most recent meetings across all competitions. Venezia have failed to take a point from any of those encounters, including a 5-1 defeat in the Coppa Italia in December 2025.
 Inter have also won on both of their last two visits to Venice without conceding. That record, combined with the visitors’ stronger form this season, makes Venezia’s task particularly challenging.

 Venezia - Struggling at the bottom
 Let’s take a closer look at Venezia’s difficult start to the season. We will analyse their current form and recent performances ahead of this challenging home game.
 Recent form
 Venezia have endured a difficult return to Serie A, collecting just three points from their opening seven league matches . They have lost seven times this season, and their defensive problems have been particularly costly, with the team conceding more than two goals per game.
 Their only recent league victory came against Napoli, whom they beat 1-0 on home soil. However, they failed to build on that result, losing 3-1 away to Atalanta before suffering a 1-0 defeat at Genoa.
 Manager Davide Nicola will hope to improve the team’s fortunes, but facing Inter’s league-leading attack represents a significant challenge. Akor Adams and John Yeboah are expected to lead the line, with captain Gianluca Busio set to return. Marin Sverko, Bartol Franjic and Andrea Adorante remain sidelined, while Thierry Correia is a fitness doubt.

 Internazionale - On a winning streak
 Let’s review Internazionale’s current situation. We will analyse the team’s momentum, their expectations and standout players for the upcoming match against Venezia.
 Recent form
 Inter remain unbeaten in Serie A and have made an impressive start to the campaign, recording six wins and one draw in their first seven matches. They returned to the top of the table after coming from behind to beat Fiorentina 2-1 last weekend, with Marcus Thuram scoring before Piotr Zieliński converted a stoppage-time penalty.
 The Nerazzurri have also won their last three league matches, beating Bologna 3-1 and Parma 3-0 before overcoming Fiorentina. Their only defeat in the recent run of fixtures across all competitions came against Club Brugge, in a 4-3 loss.
 Inter’s attack has been particularly productive, and they will look to exploit Venezia’s defensive weaknesses. However, Lautaro Martínez is still injured, while Luis Henrique, Benjamin Pavard, John Stones and Curtis Jones are also listed among the absentees.

 Predictions for Venezia vs. Internazionale - Inter to cover the spread
 Internazionale’s flawless head-to-head record and current unbeaten streak make them the clear favourites. Given their strong starts, a solid option is for Internazionale to be leading at half-time .
 Venezia’s defensive frailties have been exposed this season, while Inter boasts a potent attack averaging three goals per game. This suggests we could see over 1.5 goals in the first half .
 Considering the huge gap in quality and form between the two sides, our main prediction is for the visitors to win comfortably. Therefore, our betting tip is for Internazionale to win with a -1.5 Asian Handicap .
